unknown-top-level-field.json.why: Compose YAML leaking into the manifest

image-major-only.json.why: a major-only tag moves with every minor release

image-registry-port-no-tag.json.why: 5000 is a registry port, not a tag

provision-image-latest.json.why: the provision task image is pinned like a service image

provision-scripts-escape.json.why: scripts must stay inside the plugin directory

provider-unknown-service.json.why: provider points at a service that does not exist

subgraph-unknown-service.json.why: subgraph points at a service that does not exist

ready-missing.json.why: every capability must say how a consumer checks it is ready

ready-not-targeting-provider.json.why: localhost would probe the waiting container, not the provider

ready-image-latest.json.why: the ready image is pinned like any other image

healthcheck-timeout-zero.json.why: an attempt needs at least one second

template-typo.json.why: a typo in a template would reach the container as literal text

secret-in-command.json.why: a secret on a command line is visible to every process (ps)

consumer-in-service-env.json.why: a service has no consumer; only secrets are allowed in its env

secret-name-invalid.json.why: secret names are lowercase words joined by single underscores

extra-port-duplicate-name.json.why: two extra ports of one service share a name

extra-port-main-name.json.why: "main" is reserved for the primary port

extra-port-same-number.json.why: an extra port reuses the primary port number

duplicate-dependency.json.why: the same plugin listed twice, with different descriptions (so uniqueItems does not catch it)

authorization-without-oidc.json.why: a role rule is read from the oidc provider's tokens, so the brick must require oidc

authorization-without-subgraph.json.why: authorization applies to a GraphQL API, so it needs a subgraph

authorization-bad-role.json.why: a role name is lowercase words joined by : . _ or -, with no space

authorization-empty.json.why: an empty block says nothing: leave it out to stay at D20

authorization-unknown-class.json.why: only queries and mutations are operation classes in D22

dependency-bad-operation.json.why: a dependency uses queries or mutations of its target

external-service-and-url.json.why: a subgraph names a service or a url, not both (D33)

external-path.json.why: an external url holds its own path (D33)

external-url-credentials.json.why: no user or password in the url: it would sit in the manifest and the lock (D33)

external-url-loopback.json.why: localhost names the router's own container (D33)

external-with-services.json.why: an external brick has no services of its own (D33)

external-requires.json.why: nothing of an external brick runs here, so nothing to wire (D33)

forward-authorization-internal.json.why: the token always goes to the platform's own subgraphs; the switch is for external ones (D33)

services-empty.json.why: a brick needs a service, unless its subgraph is external (D33)
